_note: The reviewer's scored rubric (hub-qc skill). Every criterion is pass or fail with one line of evidence, recorded in spec.review.rubric. Any fail sends the page back to rework with a field-level fix. Writers do not self-score (dropped as a gate on 2026-10-07): they run QC and read the hub exemplar. Criteria come from real rejections (rules/CONTENT_DEFECTS.md); add one only with Divit's sign-off.

criteria.test: The H1, meta title and hero state the primary's whole job, not one feature of it and not a sibling page's topic. The hero description is at most 130 characters, carries the primary, leads with what the visitor gets in plain words (D1); the how-to description is one sentence of at most 140 characters that says what the steps achieve (D2).
The page delivers what the top 10 and PAA show searchers want (software comparison, examples, templates, how-to), at that depth.
Every section speaks to this page's buyer in their vocabulary; no hub-level boilerplate; the Emergent table column uses this category's variant.
Every paragraph opens with a full sentence that says what happens; no keyword labels or fragments.
Sentences end on the important word, vary in length, carry one idea each; no tacked-on clauses, no run-on lists.
Every paragraph would ship unedited on Stripe's or Linear's site; nothing reads machine-written.
Every claim is approved, every competitor fact comes from the library, every number agrees with every other.
It reads as its own page, not a sibling with the nouns swapped.

10 real, on-topic questions, none of them filler, each answered in its first sentence; links help the reader; secondaries read naturally. No question names a brand or product (PA14) or asks for a file format or download (PA15). From batch 2: 2-3 general answers (not items 1-2) carry one subtle, question-specific sentence on what Emergent does better, approved claims only, no hard sell, no competitor phrasing (F9).
Each tab shows one moment that matches its copy word for word on names, numbers and outcomes; panels read full; nothing collides or crowds.
